description: Act 1 Mission 2 - Velvet Paw Jazz Club (Yordano, ~30 min). Full story build: alley entry past the front queue, social stealth on the club floor, staff badge + two setlist clues feeding the stage setlist hack, basement server vault for the Black Ledger Shard with Yordano's help, hostile-club return, owner suite fight for the blackmail briefcase, and a bass-drop basement escape. Pacing target: exterior 3 min, floor stealth 6 min, badge/clues/setlist 7 min, basement 6 min, hostile return 4 min, suite fight 3 min, escape 2 min.

regions.label: Club Main Floor (bar west, dance floor center, VIP east)
Owner Suite - Floor 2 (reached via rig stairs teleport)
Basement - Service Level (reached via stage hatch teleport)
Club Outer Walls (front door gap center-south, staff side door gap east-south)
Stage Row Wall (wing gaps: hatch near piano at x1024, staff gate at x2048)
Stage Wing Divider (staff gate gap at south end)
VIP Rope Rail (rope gap at north end)
Owner Suite Walls (stairs arrival gap at south-west)
Basement Walls (hatch arrival gap at south-west, escape hatch gap at east)
Server Vault Cage (vault door gap at south center)
DJ Rig / Speaker Stack (owner stairs run behind this on floor plan east)
Grand Piano (service hatch just east of it)
Front Door (too crowded - queue blocks it)
Staff Side Door (the real way in)

mechanic_slots.note: Parmida and Bentley arrive on the street, west of the front queue.
Front-door bouncer works the velvet rope. Entering the queue without a wristband bounces the player back - this sells 'the front is too crowded' and pushes them toward the alley.
Two patrons in line gripe that the horn section props the staff side door open between sets. Teaches the alley route without a map marker.
Micro-cutscene intro beat: Bentley sniffs the alley ('Too many colognes. The bass line is honest, though.'). One-shot.
Optional: loose brick behind the alley. Leaving a copy of the VIP voicemail here foreshadows Rewrite Room (Mere picks it up between missions).
Poop bag 1 of 3, by the alley dumpster. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Staff side door in the alley - the actual entrance. Crossing it advances the mission to the social-stealth step. The eavesdrop zone hints at it.
House jazz set kicks in when the player steps onto the club floor from the side door.
Bouncer loop A: bar front, along the dance floor west edge, back past the bathroom door. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Bouncer on route A. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Bouncer loop B: dance floor south edge and the VIP rope gap. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Bouncer on route B. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Mission-wide social meter for the club floor. Bar task, VIP protocol, and inspection zones feed this; keep professionalism up or bouncers escalate faster.
Head bouncer scans the dance floor center. Player needs an active cover story (bar_task) or a hide/cover option to pass. Stealth angle 1.
Clearing glasses at the bar sells the 'new staff' cover story used against floor_inspection.
Glass rack: knocking it pulls the nearest bouncer to the bar for a few seconds.
Spilled drink on the floor. Bouncers who hear noise investigate here first, buying the player a route around them.
Subwoofer throb on the dance floor masks player footsteps inside its radius. Stealth angle 2.
Park Bentley by the dance floor edge before working the VIP lounge - a dog in VIP breaks the protocol zone instantly.
Slip between the two VIP booths to drop out of a bouncer's sightline.
VIP lounge etiquette: walk, no interact-spam, no dog. Ties into the vip_alt_route mutation roll - on strict rolls, require the bar_task cover first.
VIP booth phone: voicemail from Sterling's assistant ('Shred before midnight'). Reveals where the staff badge hangs in the green room and sets the flag staff_badge_pickup requires.
Camera over the VIP rope gap, sweeping the lounge. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
velvet_bathroom_glow_guy - hidden Glow Guy behind the bathroom sink. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Bentley bark line in the bathroom doorway: '(Bentley respects the grout lines.)' Points sharp-eared players at the Glow Guy.
Optional route: vent in the stage row wall. Bentley crawls from the club floor into the green room and can fetch the staff badge without the VIP voicemail lead.
Staff badge on the green room dressing rail. Main lead comes from vip_phone_search; bentley_crawl is the alternate way to reach it.
Staff gate at the south end of the stage wing divider. Unlocks with the staff badge and opens the whole stage/backstage row.
Band lockers: tip-jar cash plus a rumor note about the owner's balcony habit (soft hint at where the briefcase ends up).
Stage Manager's Notes on the green room couch table - setlist clue 2 of 2 (five songs, release-timeline order). Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Optional micro-objective: run the sound check at the wing mixing board. Completing it adds a crowd-cue hint line to the setlist puzzle.
Crumpled Setlist Fragment taped to the piano lid - setlist clue 1 of 2 (album arc order). Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Mid-mission twist: prop crates hold a DECOY ledger with blank pages. Searching it after both clues fires the 'Sterling's crew planted a prop' beat and points at the basement.

The stage setlist puzzle: reorder five songs using both clues (album arc + release timeline). Success opens the service hatch, grants the Sterling evidence clue jazz_club_encoded_setlist (connects_to: Rewrite Room), and triggers stage_presentation. Failure triggers wrong_note_alarm.
Spotlight sweep + Yordano line ('House lights love you. Don't waste the downbeat.') when the setlist is solved.

Setlist-alarm effect set: on terminal failure, red wash overlay + temporary reinforcements for ~8s. Bar Corner and Dance Floor Silhouette cover regions are the safe spots. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Reinforcement bouncer spawn used only by the setlist alarm. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Service basement hatch east of the piano. Opens when the setlist terminal is solved.
Drop through the open hatch into the basement (targets basement_arrival).
Basement arrival point at the bottom of the service ladder.
Friend beat: Yordano over the house PA explains the vault handshake hum and green-lights the shard pull. One-shot.
Camera watching the vault cage door from the north wall. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Breaker panel: reroute club power so the vault maglock drops on the next bass swell. The mission's puzzle beat for the basement.
Vault cage door (gap in the cage's south wall). Opens once vault_power has rerouted the maglock.

Black Ledger Shard on the server rack. Sets GameState.velvet_paw_basement_shard_collected; taking it upstairs later flips velvet_paw_club_hostile. Physical pickup beat separate from the encoded-setlist Sterling clue.
Optional paper-trail beat: wipe the access log terminal so the shard pull never traces back to Yordano. Lowers post-mission heat.
Optional Black Ledger Keycard behind basement storage shelves. Sets velvet_paw_basement_keycard_collected so the player can reach owner_stairs during the hostile phase without thinning every bouncer.
Optional paper-trail beat: plant a misdirection explanation on the basement breaker panel so the shard pull traces to 'equipment maintenance' instead of Yordano.
Poop bag 2 of 3, by the basement crates. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Ladder back up to the stage row (targets return_marker). Taking the shard upstairs flips the club HOSTILE - bouncers hunt instead of patrol.
Floor 1 return point just south of the piano hatch.
Hostile-club phase: escalates bouncer aggression after the shard return. Extend/wrap MissionAlertController behavior; combat-or-sneak beat.
Optional: cut the strobes at the lighting panel - hostile bouncers lose the player for ~4 seconds.
yordano_bass_drop scheme card hook: if the card is equipped, trigger a bass drop here that stuns every bouncer for 5 seconds.
Rig stairs behind the DJ stack, east edge of the floor. Opens during the hostile phase after thinning bouncers — or silently if basement_keycard was collected.
Climb to the owner suite (targets suite_arrival).
Owner suite arrival at the top of the rig stairs (south-west gap).
Laser beam across the suite corridor between the stairs and the office. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Boss beat: the club owner defends the suite (existing JazzClubOwnerArena fight). Clearing it is required for the briefcase.
Optional: plant a bug in the owner's desk phone after the fight - extra intel line for the Sterling Tower finale.
The blackmail briefcase on the balcony - the mission target. 'Grab it and don't admire the view.'
Optional shelf-goblin stash at the balcony's east end (+1 intel bonus, velvet_shelf_goblins flavor). Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Hidden perfect-moment polaroid (jazz_club_polaroid): Bentley on stage wings during the spotlight sweep after setlist_terminal. Optional; wires to hideout gallery reward.
Secret velvet_shelf_goblins collectible on the owner-suite balcony shelf. Searching after briefcase_reward sets secret_velvet_collectible for bonus intel.
Poop bag 3 of 3, near the club floor south wall. Parent under GameplayRoot/SecurityAuthoringRoot.
Basement escape hatch (east wall gap) unlocks once the briefcase is taken - Yordano cues the bass drop to cover the exit.
Bass-drop escape theme when the player re-enters the basement south end with the briefcase.
Escape through the basement hatch before the bouncers regroup. Requires escape_route's open flag and the briefcase.
